lead: The top of a page: its title and one line of description on the left, its actions on the right (a "New" button). Every page of an app starts the same way, and the **theme style** decides how (the spacing, the type scale, how the actions wrap), so the pages of different apps look alike. It is the look only: tabs, breadcrumbs and routing stay in the app. Put the main action of a page in `actions`, one primary [Button](/button), not in the toolbar of a table.

levels.title: Heading level
levels.description: The title is an h3 by default. `level` sets the heading (h1–h5) and with it the size from the theme style's type scale; a page has one h1, so use `level={1}` where the header is the page's main heading.
levels.label: Heading level

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: The header is the `page-header` slot, with `page-header-main` (the title and the description) and `page-header-actions`, styled by `page-header.css`; the title and the description are Title and Text.
